name: acquire_nagy_prior
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
lane=Path.cwd(); plan={'url':'https://arxiv.org/pdf/1211.6875','routes':['319405'],'destination':'sources/nagy.pdf','source_identity':'Zoltan Lorant Nagy Permutations over cyclic groups arXiv1211.6875','purpose':'Check actual prior theorems and remaining expressibility conjecture'}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'get-nagy.json'],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),str(lane/'get-nagy.json')],check=True)
r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/nagy.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/nagy.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print(r.stdout[:10000]); print('TAIL');print(r.stdout[-11000:])
